episodes.title: Chapter One: The Vanishing of Will Byers
episodes.description: On his way home from a friend's house, Will sees something terrifying.

episodes.title: Chapter Three: Holly, Jolly

episodes.title: Chapter Four: The Body

episodes.title: Chapter Six: The Monster
episodes.description: Jonathan looks for Nancy in the darkness, but Steve is looking for her too.

episodes.title: Chapter Seven: The Bathtub

episodes.title: Chapter Eight: The Upside Down

episodes.title: Chapter One: MADMAX
episodes.description: As the town prepares for Halloween, a high-score seeker shakes up things at the arcade.

episodes.title: Chapter Three: The Pollywog

episodes.title: Chapter One: Suzie, Do You Copy?
episodes.description: Summer in Hawkins brings a new mall and new monsters.

episodes.description: Nancy and Jonathan follow a lead. Eleven and Max go on a shopping spree.

episodes.title: Chapter Three: The Case of the Missing Lifeguard
episodes.description: With El and Max on the hunt for Billy, Will declares a day without girls.

episodes.title: Chapter Four: The Sauna Test

episodes.title: Chapter Six: E Pluribus Unum

episodes.description: The group sets a trap for a beast that has crossed over into our world.
